categories.main_business_segments: The company specializes in manufacturing soft disposable contact lenses, including daily, bi-weekly, monthly, quarterly, and yearly lenses. It offers lenses for vision correction such as myopia, hyperopia, astigmatism, presbyopia, and cosmetic lenses with additional features like vitamin-enriched and blue light blocking. The company also provides related services including product design and agency sales.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company employs key technologies in optical design, material formulation (HEMA-Base and SiHy-Base), automated production equipment, and integrated manufacturing processes including injection molding, printing, curing, hydration, sterilization, and packaging. It maintains advanced R&D capabilities focusing on biomimetic materials, smart lenses with adaptive optics, and high biocompatibility materials.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Primary customers are domestic and international branded contact lens companies, with a focus on high-end brands requiring quality and regulatory compliance. Major markets include Japan, Europe, China, and other global regions, with 87% of revenue from exports and 13% domestic sales. The company serves the medical device industry and optical retail channels.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates mainly in Taiwan with manufacturing facilities in Taoyuan City and Daxi. It has subsidiaries and investments in Vietnam, Japan, China, Singapore, and other Asian countries. Its products are certified and sold in over 41 countries including Taiwan, Japan, China, the US, Europe, and Southeast Asia.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates in the midstream segment of the supply chain as a contract manufacturer and ODM for soft contact lenses. It sources raw materials such as polymers and packaging from upstream suppliers and delivers finished lenses to downstream brand owners and distributors.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include continuous R&D investment (about 9.5% of revenue) in innovative lens materials, smart adaptive lenses, and functional lenses with health benefits. The company emphasizes regulatory certifications, automation, and sustainability initiatives such as energy efficiency and carbon footprint reduction. Future R&D plans target intelligent lenses with dynamic optical adjustment.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through product sales of soft disposable contact lenses under OEM/ODM agreements with brand customers. Additional income comes from related services such as product design and agency sales. The company also invests in subsidiaries for brand and channel development.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is among the top Taiwanese manufacturers competing in a global oligopoly dominated by Johnson & Johnson, CooperVision, Alcon, and Bausch + Lomb. It differentiates itself through flexible production, advanced automation, extensive regulatory certifications, and strong presence in Japan and emerging Asian markets.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: The company reported consolidated revenues of approximately NT$6.8 billion (about US$218 million) in the latest fiscal year, representing about 1.85% of the global soft contact lens market estimated at US$11 billion. It has shown steady revenue growth and profitability with a net income increase of over 10% year-over-year. Total assets exceed NT$14.5 billion with ongoing capital expenditures to expand production capacity.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company offers high-quality, highly certified soft contact lenses with diverse optical and functional features, supported by strong R&D and automated manufacturing. It provides flexible production to accommodate small batch and fast delivery demands, enabling customers to optimize inventory and respond to market trends. Its comprehensive multi-country certifications and one-stop service model create competitive advantages in global markets.
